SELECT o.organization_id AS organizationId, o.org_code AS orgCode, o.org_name AS orgName, o.org_type AS orgType, COALESCE(c.published_course_count, 0) AS publishedCourseCount, COALESCE(p.running_plan_count, 0) AS runningPlanCount, COALESCE(tp.participant_count, 0) AS participantCount, COALESCE(tp.completed_participant_count, 0) AS completedParticipantCount FROM sts_org_organization o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) AS published_course_count FROM sts_course_course WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY organization_id ) c ON c.organization_id = o.organization_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) AS running_plan_count FROM sts_training_plan WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND publish_status = 'RUNNING' GROUP BY organization_id ) p ON p.organization_id = o.organization_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) AS participant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN participant_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_participant_count FROM sts_training_participant WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY organization_id ) tp ON tp.organization_id = o.organization_id WHERE
ORDER BY o.organization_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_org_organization o WHERE
AND o.org_type = 'ENTERPRISE') AS enterpriseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_org_organization o WHERE
AND o.org_type = 'TRAINING_INSTITUTION') AS trainingInstitutionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_training_plan p INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = p.organization_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND) AS planTotalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_training_plan p INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = p.organization_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.publish_status = 'RUNNING' AND) AS runningPlanCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_training_plan p INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = p.organization_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.publish_status = 'ENDED' AND) AS endedPlanCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_training_participant tp INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = tp.organization_id WHERE tp.deleted = 0 AND) AS participantCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_training_participant tp INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = tp.organization_id WHERE tp.deleted = 0 AND tp.participant_status = 'COMPLETED' AND) AS completedParticipantCount

SELECT o.organization_id AS organizationId, o.org_code AS orgCode, o.org_name AS orgName, o.org_type AS orgType, COALESCE(p.plan_count, 0) AS planCount, COALESCE(tp.participant_count, 0) AS participantCount FROM sts_org_organization o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) AS plan_count FROM sts_training_plan WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY organization_id ) p ON p.organization_id = o.organization_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) AS participant_count FROM sts_training_participant WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY organization_id ) tp ON tp.organization_id = o.organization_id WHERE
ORDER BY o.org_name

SELECT t.training_type_id AS trainingTypeId, t.type_name AS typeName, COUNT(*) AS planCount FROM sts_training_plan p INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = p.organization_id INNER JOIN sts_training_type t ON t.training_type_id = p.training_type_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND
GROUP BY t.training_type_id, t.type_name ORDER BY planCount DESC, t.training_type_id

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT p.training_plan_id), 0) AS planCount, COALESCE(COUNT(tp.training_participant_id), 0) AS participantCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tp.participant_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedParticipantCount FROM sts_training_plan p INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = p.organization_id INNER JOIN sts_training_type t ON t.training_type_id = p.training_type_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sts_training_participant tp ON tp.training_plan_id = p.training_plan_id AND tp.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND t.tag = '特种作业' AND
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_regulation_warning WHERE deleted = 0 AND warning_status = 'UNREAD'
mapper.sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM us_sys_user u INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = u.organization_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND IFNULL(u.member_type, '') <> 'REGULATOR' AND
AND u.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AS employeeAccountCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sts_course_enrollment e INNER JOIN sts_course_offering off ON off.course_offering_id = e.course_offering_id AND off.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = e.organization_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND
AND e.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AS classSessionCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) FROM sts_course_enrollment e INNER JOIN sts_course_offering off ON off.course_offering_id = e.course_offering_id AND off.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = e.organization_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND
AND e.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AS classLearnerCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_offering_id) FROM sts_course_enrollment e INNER JOIN sts_course_offering off ON off.course_offering_id = e.course_offering_id AND off.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = e.organization_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND
AND e.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AS participatingOfferingCount
mapper.select: SELECT #{organizationId} AS organizationId, metrics.employeeAccountCount AS employeeAccountCount, metrics.classSessionCount AS classSessionCount, metrics.classLearnerCount AS classLearnerCount, metrics.participatingOfferingCount AS participatingOfferingCount, CASE WHEN metrics.classLearnerCount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE metrics.classSessionCount / metrics.classLearnerCount END AS avgSessionsPerLearner, CASE WHEN metrics.employeeAccountCount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE metrics.classLearnerCount / metrics.employeeAccountCount END AS participationRate FROM () metrics

SELECT o.organization_id AS organizationId, o.org_code AS orgCode, o.org_name AS orgName, o.org_type AS orgType, COALESCE(emp.cnt, 0) AS employeeAccountCount, COALESCE(enr.session_count, 0) AS classSessionCount, COALESCE(enr.learner_count, 0) AS classLearnerCount, COALESCE(enr.offering_count, 0) AS participatingOfferingCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(enr.learner_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE enr.session_count / enr.learner_count END AS avgSessionsPerLearner, CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp.cnt, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE enr.learner_count / emp.cnt END AS participationRate FROM sts_org_organization o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM us_sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND IFNULL(member_type, '') <> 'REGULATOR' GROUP BY organization_id ) emp ON emp.organization_id = o.organization_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.organization_id, COUNT(*) AS session_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS learner_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_offering_id) AS offering_count FROM sts_course_enrollment e INNER JOIN sts_course_offering off ON off.course_offering_id = e.course_offering_id AND off.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.organization_id ) enr ON enr.organization_id = o.organization_id WHERE
ORDER BY o.org_name

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.user_code AS userCode, e.organization_id AS organizationId, COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_offering_id) AS offeringCount FROM sts_course_enrollment e INNER JOIN sts_course_offering off ON off.course_offering_id = e.course_offering_id AND off.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = e.organization_id INNER JOIN us_sys_user u ON u.user_id = e.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND
AND e.organization_id = #{organizationId} GROUP BY e.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_code, e.organization_id ORDER BY offeringCount DESC, e.user_id

SELECT off.course_offering_id AS courseOfferingId, off.offering_name AS offeringName, off.organization_id AS organizationId, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS learnerCount FROM sts_course_enrollment e INNER JOIN sts_course_offering off ON off.course_offering_id = e.course_offering_id AND off.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = e.organization_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND
AND e.organization_id = #{organizationId} GROUP BY off.course_offering_id, off.offering_name, off.organization_id ORDER BY learnerCount DESC, off.course_offering_id
